Campus





The permanent campus of Bangladesh University of Business and Technology (BUBT) is located at Rupnagar, Mirpur-2, Dhaka-1216. The campus comprises three spacious academic buildings equipped with all essential facilities required for quality higher education, ensuring a supportive and modern learning environment for students. Situated within a well-established educational zone, the campus is surrounded by several reputed educational institutions, creating an excellent academic atmosphere.

BUBT enjoys strong and convenient communication links with all parts of Dhaka City as well as areas outside the city. The campus is easily accessible by private cars, public buses, taxis, and rickshaws. To further facilitate student transportation, the University currently operates five dedicated bus services covering key routes of the city, ensuring safe and reliable commuting for students and staff. 

In addition, the campus is conveniently connected to the Dhaka Metro Rail, with Mirpur and Pallabi stations located within close proximity, allowing easy and time-efficient access to the University. For physical development and co-curricular activities, BUBT maintains a designated playground at Mirpur Beribadh, where students regularly participate in sports and recreational programs.

With its modern infrastructure, excellent connectivity, and student-friendly facilities, BUBT provides a safe, accessible, and academically enriched environment that supports quality education and holistic student development.
